definitions.meaning: A deterministic derivation of finite neutral cases from one admitted typed SFOL clause, explicit witness domains, a versioned strategy, and explicit resource bounds.
A content-addressed known-bad change applied at one declared evidence seam to prove that its expected detector can reject the change for the declared reason.
A versioned declaration of one known-bad change, its applicable seam, expected detector, and claim ceiling.
Exact evidence that a detector accepted or rejected one negative control, preserving expected and observed reasons without inferring absent results.
An exact matrix whose rows are negative controls and columns are detectors, with every applicable cell explicitly observed, unsupported, invalid, indeterminate, or survived.
Evidence that two typed SFOL expressions return equal values over one exact declared exhaustive finite domain; it is not global logical equivalence.
Revalidation of one proof receipt against an exact allowlist of semantic, tool, target, binding, and artifact digests.
An additive compatibility boundary that preserves predecessor evidence bytes while routing successor invocations through one stable API and CLI.

claim_limit: Definition proposals only; canonical DomainSpec definitions remain unchanged until a separate definition-owner decision binds these exact bytes.
